title: Flooring Ellenton, FL | Vinyl Plank, Tile & Laminate
description: Flooring installers in Ellenton, FL for manufactured-home communities and gated subdivisions near the Manatee River. Typical 2026 pricing from $1.75/sq ft.
lede: We install vinyl plank, tile and laminate flooring in Ellenton's manufactured-home communities and newer gated subdivisions along the Manatee River.
capsule: Sarasota Flooring Company installs vinyl plank, tile and laminate in Ellenton's mix of 1970s manufactured-home communities and newer gated subdivisions like Covered Bridge Estates. With several age-restricted communities in town, floating vinyl and easy-care tile are the most requested floors, sized for lighter manufactured-home subfloors. In Ellenton, 2026 installed pricing runs $1.75 to $10 per square foot. Ellenton is about 13 miles, roughly 30 minutes, from downtown Sarasota.

intro_html:
Ellenton sits on the north side of the tidal Manatee River, unincorporated Manatee County land organized around the I-75/US 301 interchange at Exit 224 and Ellenton Premium Outlets. Several of the town's named communities, including Colony Cove, Tidevue Estates, Ridgewood Estates and North River Estates, are age-restricted manufactured-home communities dating mostly from the 1970s, sitting alongside newer, non-restricted gated subdivisions like Covered Bridge Estates, built starting in 2000, and Bougainvillea Place.

Manufactured homes change the flooring conversation. Most sit on a steel chassis with a particleboard or OSB subfloor rather than a concrete slab, so solid hardwood nail-down and heavy tile setups are usually the wrong call; floating LVP or glue-down vinyl designed for a lighter-frame subfloor performs better and doesn't add weight the structure wasn't built for. In the newer subdivisions like Covered Bridge Estates, the calculation flips back to a standard slab-on-grade approach, closer to what we'd spec in Palmetto or Parrish.

The riverfront edge of town, including Highland Shores and Colony Cove, sits close enough to the tidal Manatee River to fall within FEMA-mapped flood zones, and we treat those jobs with the same moisture caution we'd use on a canal lot in Apollo Beach. Permits for anything beyond floor coverings themselves go through Manatee County's Building Division; Ellenton has no city hall of its own. Most flooring jobs here start the same way regardless of house type: a moisture and subfloor check before we quote material, not after.

sections.html: A single-wide or double-wide in Ridgewood Estates or Tidevue Estates typically has a particleboard subfloor over a steel frame, not a poured slab, and the existing floor is often carpet or peel-and-stick vinyl tile from the original build. We usually recommend a floating floor system, wide-plank SPC or WPC vinyl, or glue-down sheet vinyl rated for manufactured housing, and we check the subfloor for soft spots and water staining before quoting, since replacing a section of particleboard changes the scope of the job. If you're searching flooring installers near me from one of Ellenton's 55+ communities, we work these jobs regularly and plan for the subfloor difference going in.

sections.h2: What does flooring cost in Ellenton in 2026?
sections.html: A 900 sq ft manufactured home in North River Estates replacing worn vinyl with standard 12-mil LVP at $1.75–$3.25 per sq ft typically runs $1,575–$2,925 installed. A larger, 1,800 sq ft home in Covered Bridge Estates or South Oak on a standard slab, upgrading to mid-range SPC vinyl at $2.75–$5.50 per sq ft, runs closer to $4,950–$9,900. These are typical 2026 ranges, not quotes; subfloor type matters as much as square footage in Ellenton pricing. For other Ellenton project sizes, open the cost guide or run the flooring cost calculator. Removal of the original vinyl or carpet is usually included in that range for a manufactured home, since there's rarely a thick glued-tile layer underneath to chip out the way there is in an older site-built ranch.

sections.h2: Riverfront flood-zone flooring near Highland Shores and Colony Cove
sections.html: Homes and manufactured units along the Manatee River in Highland Shores and Colony Cove sit close enough to the water to fall within a mapped flood zone. We test moisture before quoting any of these jobs and lean toward waterproof flooring over solid hardwood, since a riverfront lot is more exposed to a wind-driven surge event than an inland Ellenton subdivision. For manufactured homes in this zone specifically, a floating waterproof plank also has the advantage of coming up cleanly if a section ever needs replacing after a flood, unlike a glued-down product. We also check what's under the existing floor before we quote, since some of these units still have original 1970s materials that need proper handling on removal.

service_notes.hardwood-flooring: Solid hardwood is a poor fit for Ellenton's manufactured homes; we reserve it mainly for slab-built subdivisions like Covered Bridge Estates.
service_notes.vinyl-plank-flooring: Floating SPC or WPC vinyl plank is the default in Ridgewood Estates and Tidevue Estates, sized for a lighter manufactured-home subfloor.
service_notes.tile-installation: Tile works best in Ellenton's slab-built subdivisions; we avoid heavy tile setups on manufactured-home particleboard subfloors.
service_notes.laminate-flooring: Laminate needs a firm, flat subfloor, so we check for soft spots before quoting it in any of Ellenton's older manufactured homes.
service_notes.stair-treads: Stair treads are rare in Ellenton's single-story manufactured-home parks; most of that work is in two-story homes near Covered Bridge Estates.
service_notes.floor-repair: We repair a fair number of Ellenton floors laid over water-damaged particleboard, a problem more common here than in slab-built neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Can you install hardwood or tile in a manufactured home in Ellenton?
faqs.a: We can, but we check the subfloor first. Most Ellenton manufactured homes have a particleboard or OSB subfloor on a steel frame rather than a concrete slab, so heavy tile and nail-down hardwood usually aren't a good match; floating vinyl plank or engineered products built for lighter subfloors typically perform better.

faqs.q: Who handles building permits in Ellenton?
faqs.a: Ellenton is unincorporated, so there's no city hall; permits go through Manatee County's Building Division. Floor coverings themselves are typically exempt from permitting under Florida's building code, whether the home is manufactured or site-built.

faqs.q: Is Highland Shores or Colony Cove in a flood zone?
faqs.a: Riverfront communities along the tidal Manatee River, including Highland Shores and Colony Cove, generally fall within a FEMA-mapped flood zone. We test slab or subfloor moisture and typically recommend waterproof vinyl plank or tile for homes in that area.

faqs.q: How far is Ellenton from downtown Sarasota?
faqs.a: Ellenton is about 13 miles and roughly 30 minutes from downtown Sarasota, just off I-75 near the outlet mall.
